description: This Java class 'AttributeModifiedStrategy' defines a strategy for handling 'AttributeModified' events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy and implements logic to update a 'ThingBuilder' based on received attribute modification events.

classes.name: AttributeModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a specific event handling strategy for 'AttributeModified' events, extending 'AbstractThingEventStrategy'.

methods.name: AttributeModifiedStrategy()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy by calling the superclass constructor.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to apply the 'AttributeModified' event to a 'ThingBuilder' instance by setting the specified attribute with its new value.
